guide.overview: An Ultimate kill lets Superman Death Metal chain **follow-up attacks** for massive physical damage. He can also fight back from the brink of defeat and give his [Superman Family] allies a boost.

legacyPieces.name: Arm of Apokolips
legacyPieces.reason: Greatly boosts Superman Death Metal's Ultimate damage and allows him to follow up even if his Ultimate doesn't score a kill.

legacyPieces.name: Promethium Claws
legacyPieces.reason: Improves Superman Death Metal's crits and helps him keep hitting hard after his Ultimate, making it a great fit for his burst-heavy playstyle.

legacyPieces.name: Not-So-Huge Hammer
legacyPieces.reason: Gives Superman Death Metal more power to help finish off enemies.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: A solid all-around boost that helps Superman Death Metal hold his own in longer fights.
